text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Wonder 
Acute...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Wonder Acute 
pointed, I saw a crane game filled with 
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "My, my... What a truly adorable plushie."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I had something similar when I was young, 
too. Couldn't get to sleep without it, 
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, I'll give one a try. It's kind 
of like yo-yo fishing, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I couldn't get a good grip on it 
again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It seems these beeping and button-mashing 
games really aren't suited for me after 
all.
choice_data_list: Want me to win that plushie for you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you sure? Well then, I'll take 
you up on that offer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
